description: Reassemble the complete laser-melting Fortran solver into a single gfortran-portable fixed-form file at AMMAN/laser_melting/laser_melt.f. Inline PARAM.FOR (the PARAMETER line) immediately BEFORE the inlined COMMON.FOR block inside EVERY routine that originally used INCLUDE 'PARAM.FOR' / INCLUDE 'COMMON.FOR'. Port Compaq/DVF GETDAT/GETTIM to standard DATE_AND_TIME in SUBROUTINE GETIME. Convert diagnostic PAUSE statements to non-halting WRITE. Fix any fixed-form column/tab/continuation issues. Preserve all numerical constants, physics, OPEN units/filenames, FORMAT labels, ENTRY statements, and COMMON/EQUIVALENCE usage EXACTLY as specified. This is independent, self-contained work (no other repo code depends on it).
steps: Create directory AMMAN/laser_melting/ and file laser_melt.f (fixed-form Fortran).

Define the inlined header once as a reusable block: the PARAM.FOR line 'PARAMETER(NI=242,NJ=242,NIJ=242,NFMAX=39,NFX3=NFMAX+3,NZMAX=152)' followed immediately by the full COMMON.FOR contents (BLK01..BLK16, plus DIMENSION U/V/PC/P + EQUIVALENCE, UOLD/VOLD + EQUIVALENCE, COF/COFU/COFV/COFP + EQUIVALENCE, TH/THU/THDIF/THCV/THCVS + EQUIVALENCE). Both PARAM.FOR and COMMON.FOR bodies are provided VERBATIM in the user_instruction; reproduce them character-faithfully, only adjusting fixed-form column placement so gfortran -std=legacy accepts them. The PARAMETER line MUST come before the COMMON blocks in every routine because NI/NJ/NIJ/NFMAX/NZMAX are used in the COMMON dimensions.

Emit PROGRAM MAIN with the inlined header, then: CALL GETIME(1); CALL DEFLT; CALL GRID; OPEN(7,FILE=PRINTF); CALL SETUP1; CALL BEGIN; CALL DENSE; CALL UPDATE; DO 10 ISTEP=1,NSTPS { CALL GTIME; CALL OUTPUT; TIME=TIME+DT; CALL TIMITR; CALL BOUND; CALL OUPT1 }; 10 CONTINUE; STOP; END. (Any routine that references COMMON variables must include the inlined header.)

Emit SUBROUTINE TIMITR, UPDATE, SAVE, START, RESET1 exactly per the orchestrator_briefing specification, each with the inlined header where COMMON is used. UPDATE loops over I=1,L1 J=1,M1 N=1,NFMAX copying F->FOLD and RHO->RHOLD then ITER=0. SAVE/START use unit 90 UNFORMATTED with SAVEF/STARTF. RESET1 zeros AP,AIM,AIP,AJM,AJP,CON over J=1,M1 I=1,L1.

Emit SUBROUTINE SETUP with ENTRY DEFLT, ENTRY SETUP1, ENTRY SETUP2 per spec: DIMENSION UHAT(NI,NJ),VHAT(NI,NJ); FORMAT 1-4; DEFLT sets PRINTF='print.dat', NP=4, PI, IU1=6,IU2=7, XL=YL=1, NCVLX=NCVLY=5, zone defaults (loop 1101), SMALL=1.E-17, BIG=1.E17, MODE=1, LAST=10, TIME=0, DT=BIG, IPREF=JPREF=1, RHOCON=1, KSTOP=0, loop 1100 zeroing KSOLVE/KPRINT/KBLK and RELAX=1/NTIMES=10, loops 1102-1104 zeroing F/FOLD; SETUP1 computes L2/L3/M2/M3, geometry arrays X,Y,XDIF,XCV,XCVS,XCVI,XCVIP,YDIF,YCV,YCVS, R/RMN by MODE, SX/SXMN, YCVR/ARX, YCVRS, ARXJ/ARXJP by MODE, FV/FVP, FX/FXM, FY/FYM, initializes CON/AP/U/V/PC/P and RHO/RHOLD=RHOCON, prints MODE header to units 6 and 7; SETUP2 assembles COFU (NF=1,IST=3,JST=2, CALL DENSE, CALL GAMSOR, DIFLOW-based AIM/AIP/AJM/AJP, APT transient, DU), COFV (NF=2, CALL RESET, IST=2,JST=3, ...DV), computes UHAT/VHAT, pressure eq coefficients (NF=3), CALL SOLVE, corrects U,V via DU/DV and PC (SIMPLE velocity-correction block), then loops N=5,NFMAX for scalar/temperature equations with CALL RESET/DENSE/GAMSOR, DIFLOW coefficients, APT/APTNEW transient, CALL LC, CALL SOLVE. Commented-out debug/PAUSE lines may be kept as comments or dropped.

Emit SUBROUTINE VISDIS (MODE 1 and 2 branches computing SHEAR from DUDX,DVDY,DUDY,DVDX, plus TERM3 with VP/R(J) for axisymmetric), TSOR (SCUR=VIS*SHEAR**2 with RELSOR relaxation into CON, local DIMENSION SHOLD(NI,NJ)), USOR (MODE 1/2 extra stress terms DUDXX,DVDXY, ISOLID-aware GAMP interpolation, -2/3 dilatation into CON), VSOR (analogous to USOR for V-momentum, includes AP(I,J)-=TERM1 with 2*GAMP/RMN**2 in axisymmetric).
Emit SUBROUTINE DIFLOW(FLOW,DIFF,ACOF) DOUBLE PRECISION power-law scheme: ACOF=DIFF*(1-0.1*ABS(FLOW)/DIFF)**5 clamped (AMAX1/DMAX1 style, standard Patankar power law).

Emit SUBROUTINE SOLVE with ENTRY RESET: line-by-line TDMA sweeps (block-correction when KBLK(NF).NE.0 then four ADI sweeps) using PT/QT arrays over NTIMES(NF); ENTRY RESET zeroes CON and AP over 2..L2 / 2..M2. A trailing WRITE(*,*)'HELLOSOLVE' may be kept or dropped (harmless).

Emit SUBROUTINE SUPPLY with ENTRY UGRID/EZGRID/ZGRID/PRINT: FORMAT labels 10,20,30,40,50,51-57; UGRID uniform grid; EZGRID power-law grid; ZGRID zone-by-zone grid; PRINT computes stream function (KPRINT(3)), extrapolates boundary pressures (KPRINT(4)), prints all fields with KPRINT(NF) to units 6 and 7.

Emit SUBROUTINE TCPLT (unit 31, VARIABLES X,Y,U,V,T with F(I,J,5) and -ISOLID), INOUT (FLIN/FLOUT mass balance to unit 6), TCPLT1 (unit 31, X,Y,T,TE=F5,F6), TCPLTU (unit 31, X,Y,U,V,T,T1 with cell-centered U,V averaging).

Emit SUBROUTINE USER with ENTRY GRID/BEGIN/DENSE/GTIME/BOUND/OUPT1/OUTPUT/GAMSOR/LC exactly per spec. DIMENSION T,TOLD,TPI,FACT1O,RSOLID,APSUM,FACT1(NI,NJ),XFL(NJ); EQUIVALENCE (F(1,1,5),T),(FOLD(1,1,5),TOLD),(F(1,1,6),FACT1),(F(1,1,7),RSOLID),(FOLD(1,1,6),FACT1O). GRID: MODE=2; OPEN units 660,652,650,653,112,150,23,30,670 with filenames LIQUID_FRONT-TEMP-DEPENDENT.xls, SYMMETRYAXIS_TEMP.xls, LEFT_WALL_TEMP.xls, CENTRE_WORKPIECE_TEMP.xls, TEMPERATURE-CHECK.xls, MAXVEL-TIME.xls, DIFFMAX.DAT, TCPLT.DAT, MELT-DEPTH.xls; TITLE(5)='T', TITLE(8)='PHASE'; KSOLVE(1..5)=1; RELAX(1)=0.5,(2)=0.5,(3)=0.6,(4)=0.6,(5)=0.9,(6)=0.1; zone grid NZX=4 with XZONE/POWRX/NCVX per zone, NZY=5 with YZONE/POWRY/NCVY per zone; CALL ZGRID; NSTPS=1.D08, NREPT=3000, DT=1.0D-06. BEGIN: physical constants DENREF=2700,DENS=2700,DENL=2385,TSOLID=838,TLIQUID=848,TPC,EBS,CONDL=94,CONDS=238,AMU=2.96D-03,CPL=1080,CPS=917,HIF=3.96D05,GRAV=9.81,BETA=69.0D-6,TREF=0,CMUSH=1.6D06,B=1.0D-03,TINIT=300,HTC=1.0D04,REFLECS=0.87,REFLECL=0.84,PKINTENSITY=5.0D09,ABSORCOF=6.17D06,SIGMA=5.67D-08,SURTENSION=3.0D-04,TBOILING=2793,BEAMRAD=700.0D-06,ASQUARE=BEAMRAD**2,TP=2.0D-03,TR=0.2D-03,TF=0.1D-03,EROR=1.0D-04; init T,TPI,TOLD=TINIT, RSOLID=1, FACT1/FACT1O=0, U=V=0. DENSE: RHO(1..4)=DEN1 (FACT1-weighted DENL/DENS), RHO(5)=RHOCP (FACT1-weighted DENL*CPL/DENS*CPS); copy T into TPI interior. GTIME: RETURN only. BOUND: symmetry bottom wall (T(I,1)=T(I,2),U(I,1)=U(I,2),V(I,2)=0), left wall U(2,J)=0 and convective+radiative BC computing T(1,J) via RADRES/HTC/COND. OUPT1: liquid-front XFL(J) to 670; at ISTEP=500/1000/1500/2000 headers+profiles to 660,112,652,650; centre temp to 653; UMAX/VMAX/VELMAX to 150 every 25 steps and screen; every 25 steps set RSOLID/FACT1 boundary values and CALL TCPLTE(RSOLID,FACT1); if TIME>2.0D-03 CALL GETIME(2) then STOP. OUTPUT: if ITER>=1 update FACT1 via enthalpy-porosity APT=DENL*HIF*ARX*XCV/DT then APSUM/APT, clamp FACT1 to [0,1], recompute RHO, compute DIFF/DIFFMAX convergence (mass residual SMAX/SSUM when KSOLVE(1|2)=1), set KSTOP, at convergence check 'MORE THAN ONE CV MELT' and 'VPOR FORMS' if T>=TBOILING, write DIFFMAX summary to screen and unit 23 -- PORT: convert the two PAUSE to non-halting WRITE. GAMSOR: NF-dependent (NF=1 U-momentum GAM=AMU-based + Darcy source AP=-CMUSH*(1-eps)**2/(eps**3+B) + buoyancy CON=DENREF*GRAV*BETA*(T-TREF); NF=2 V-momentum similar + axisymmetric AP2=-GAM/RMN**2; NF=5 energy GAM=conductivity with boundary GAM zeros, laser surface source Gaussian radial + Beer-Lambert axial gated by pulse shape FT (ramp TR, plateau to TP1=TP-TF, fall TF), enthalpy source ENTSRCPERVOL, upwind rho-u-h convective correction CONVT, left-wall convective-radiative source CONEXTRA/APEXTRA into CON(2,J)/AP(2,J)). LC: APSUM(I,J)=AP(I,J) over interior.

Emit SUBROUTINE TCPLTE(RSOLID,FACT1) with DIMENSION RSOLID(NI,NJ),FACT1(NI,NJ); writes Tecplot to unit 30 with X,Y,U,V,F5,FACT1 (cell-centered U,V). Ensure a clean line break between END of TCPLTE and the start of GETIME.

Emit SUBROUTINE GETIME(INDX) ported to DATE_AND_TIME: use INTEGER IV(8); CALL DATE_AND_TIME(VALUES=IV) where IV(1)=year,IV(2)=month,IV(3)=day,IV(5)=hour,IV(6)=min,IV(7)=sec. For INDX=1 capture start into a SAVEd local array (or a COMMON); for INDX=2 capture end, WRITE start (FORMAT 10) and end (FORMAT 20) 'PROGRAM STARTED/ENDED ON' lines and compute TOTAL RUN TIME in seconds (FORMAT 30) handling same-day vs cross-day as the original did. Preserve FORMAT labels 10,20,30 and elapsed-seconds arithmetic. Writes go to unit 6 and unit 7.

Throughout: replace every INCLUDE 'PARAM.FOR' and INCLUDE 'COMMON.FOR' with the inlined PARAM-then-COMMON header. No INCLUDE statements may remain. No PAUSE statements may remain. No GETDAT/GETTIM calls may remain. Ensure all lines fit fixed-form (use -ffixed-line-length-132 if needed; keep continuations in column 6; no literal tabs that break columns).
Add AMMAN/laser_melting/.gitignore ignoring compiled artifacts: laser_melt, *.o, *.mod, *.exe.

Compile: cd /projects/sandbox/AMMAN/laser_melting && gfortran -std=legacy -ffixed-line-length-132 -o laser_melt laser_melt.f (add -fno-automatic and/or -w only if needed). Iterate on fixed-form/continuation/typing errors until it compiles with no ERROR diagnostics.

Record in the feature 'findings' field: the exact final compile command used, whether it succeeded, and a concise list of the porting edits made (INCLUDE inlining, GETDAT/GETTIM->DATE_AND_TIME, PAUSE->WRITE, any column/continuation fixes).
acceptance_criteria: File AMMAN/laser_melting/laser_melt.f exists and is a single self-contained fixed-form Fortran source.

Running 'gfortran -std=legacy -ffixed-line-length-132 -o laser_melt laser_melt.f' (with at most the additional flags -fno-automatic/-w) exits 0 with no ERROR diagnostics and produces the laser_melt executable.
grep confirms zero occurrences of INCLUDE, zero PAUSE, zero GETDAT, zero GETTIM in laser_melt.f.

The PARAMETER(NI=242,...) line appears immediately before each inlined COMMON block; COMMON.FOR and PARAM.FOR contents match the verbatim text given in the user_instruction (modulo fixed-form column adjustments).

Exactly one PROGRAM MAIN and one definition of each named SUBROUTINE (TIMITR, UPDATE, SAVE, START, RESET1, SETUP, VISDIS, TSOR, USOR, VSOR, DIFLOW, SOLVE, SUPPLY, TCPLT, INOUT, TCPLT1, TCPLTU, USER, TCPLTE, GETIME) are present; all ENTRY points listed in the spec are present.
SUBROUTINE GETIME uses DATE_AND_TIME(VALUES=...) and preserves FORMAT labels 10,20,30 and elapsed-seconds arithmetic.
All numeric constants, OPEN unit numbers, and filenames match the specification exactly.
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/AMMAN/laser_melting && gfortran -std=legacy -ffixed-line-length-132 -o laser_melt laser_melt.f; echo EXIT=$?
grep -c -iE 'INCLUDE|PAUSE|GETDAT|GETTIM' laser_melt.f (expect 0 for each; use separate greps)
findings: Final compile command: cd /projects/sandbox/AMMAN/laser_melting && gfortran -std=legacy -ffixed-line-length-132 -o laser_melt laser_melt.f . Result: EXIT=0, zero error diagnostics AND zero warnings, laser_melt executable (85784 bytes) produced. No additional flags (-fno-automatic / -w) were needed. Verification greps: INCLUDE=0, PAUSE=0, GETDAT=0, GETTIM=0, DATE_AND_TIME>=1 (all pass). Porting edits made: (1) INCLUDE inlining: replaced every INCLUDE 'PARAM.FOR'/INCLUDE 'COMMON.FOR' with the inlined header (PARAMETER line first, then full COMMON.FOR block including all EQUIVALENCE aliases) in all 19 routines that use COMMON (PROGRAM MAIN, TIMITR, UPDATE, SAVE, START, RESET1, SETUP, VISDIS, TSOR, USOR, VSOR, SOLVE, SUPPLY, TCPLT, INOUT, TCPLT1, TCPLTU, USER, TCPLTE); DIFLOW and GETIME take no COMMON so use only IMPLICIT DOUBLE PRECISION. Zero INCLUDE statements remain. (2) GETDAT/GETTIM -> DATE_AND_TIME: SUBROUTINE GETIME now uses INTEGER IV(8) and CALL DATE_AND_TIME(VALUES=IV) with IV(1)=year, IV(2)=month, IV(3)=day, IV(5)=hour, IV(6)=min, IV(7)=sec; INDX=1 captures start into SAVEd locals, INDX=2 captures end, writes FORMAT 10 (started) and 20 (ended) plus FORMAT 30 (total run time in seconds) to units 6 and 7, with same-day vs cross-day (IDE.NE.IDS adds 86400*days) elapsed-seconds arithmetic. (3) PAUSE -> non-halting WRITE: converted 2 diagnostic PAUSE statements in ENTRY OUTPUT ('MORE THAN ONE CV MELT' and 'VPOR FORMS') to WRITE to units 6 and 7. Zero PAUSE remain. (4) Fixed-form/column fixes: all continuations placed in column 6, statements in column 7+, numeric labels in columns 1-5, no literal tabs; ensured a clean line break between END of TCPLTE and SUBROUTINE GETIME. (5) One recursion fix required by gfortran: ENTRY OUTPUT of SUBROUTINE USER originally did CALL DENSE (another ENTRY of the same USER subprogram), which gfortran rejects as recursion under -std=legacy; replaced that single self-call with an in-line copy of the identical DENSE density-recompute loop (numerically identical: RHO(*,1..4)=FACT1-weighted DENL/DENS, RHO(*,5)=FACT1-weighted DENL*CPL/DENS*CPS), so no external flags were needed and the base compile command succeeds. All numeric constants, OPEN unit numbers/filenames, FORMAT labels, ENTRY points, COMMON blocks BLK01..BLK16, and EQUIVALENCE aliases preserved per spec.
